sid.description: A 34 character string that uniquely identifies this resource.

account_sid.description: The unique ID of the [Account](https://www.twilio.com/docs/iam/api/account) responsible for this credential.

friendly_name.description: The human-readable name of this credential, limited to 64 characters. Optional.

type.description: The type of push-notification service the credential is for. Can be: `fcm`, `gcm`, or `apn`.

sandbox.description: [APN only] Whether to send the credential to sandbox APNs. Can be `true` to send to sandbox APNs or `false` to send to production.

date_created.description: The date that this resource was created.

date_updated.description: The date that this resource was last updated.

url.description: An absolute API resource URL for this credential.
